Create an interactive band chart

Source: R/areaband.R
area_band.Rd

Draws a shaded band between a lower and an upper value over time, such as a daily minimum and maximum, a confidence or forecast interval, or a target range, optionally with a central line (y, for example the mean or the median). With group, one band per group is drawn. It shares the interactions of line_chart(): a crosshair tooltip showing each band's range, range buttons, a navigator, drag-to-zoom (double-click to reset) and a clickable legend.

Usage

area_band(
  data,
  x,
  y_lower,
  y_upper,
  fill = NULL,
  stroke = NULL,
  stroke_width = NULL,
  x_ticks = NULL,
  y_ticks = NULL,
  x_title = NULL,
  x_title_font_size = 13,
  y_title = NULL,
  y_title_font_size = 13,
  title = NULL,
  title_font_size = 20,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  bg_col = "white",
  opacity = NULL,
  axis_col = "#333333",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  y = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  line_width = 2,
  curve = "curveLinear",
  y_zero = FALSE,
  events = NULL,
  bands = NULL,
  h_lines = NULL,
  legend = NULL,
  end_labels = NULL,
  tooltip = TRUE,
  navigator = TRUE,
  range_buttons = TRUE,
  zoom = TRUE,
  animate = TRUE,
  value_format = NULL,
  value_prefix = "",
  value_suffix = "",
  date_format = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  subtitle_font_size = 13,
  x_font_size = 11,
  y_font_size = 11,
  grid_col = "#e9e9e9"
)

Arguments

data

A data frame, or a ts / mts object.

x

The time variable: a Date, a POSIXct date-time, a "yyyy-mm-dd" character column or a number.

y_lower

The column holding the lower bound of the band.

y_upper

The column holding the upper bound of the band.

fill

The colour of the band (and of the central line). A single colour, or one colour per group (a named vector maps colours to groups). Defaults to a built-in palette.

stroke

Optional. The colour of the band's outline. Without y, the outline defaults to a faded line in the band's colour.

stroke_width

Optional. The width of the band's outline. Defaults to 1.

x_ticks

Optional. The approximate number of x-axis ticks.

y_ticks

Optional. The approximate number of y-axis ticks.

x_title

Optional. The title of the x-axis.

x_title_font_size

The font size of the x-axis title. Defaults to 13.

y_title

Optional. The title of the y-axis, shown above the axis.

y_title_font_size

The font size of the y-axis title. Defaults to 13.

title

Optional. The title of the plot.

title_font_size

The font size of the plot title. Defaults to 20.

font

The font family to consider for the titles. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

bg_col

The background color of the SVG. Defaults to "white".

opacity

Optional. The opacity of the band (from 0 to 1). Defaults to 0.3, or 0.22 with a central line.

axis_col

The color of the axis text, ticks and titles. Defaults to "#333333".

width

Optional. The width of the SVG output.

height

Optional. The height of the SVG output.

y

Optional. A column drawn as a line inside the band.

group

Optional. The column whose values name the bands (one band per value, long data).

line_width

The width of the central line. Defaults to 2.

curve

The line's curve type. A complete list can be found here <https://github.com/d3/d3-shape#curves>. Defaults to 'curveLinear'; 'curveMonotoneX' gives smooth lines that never overshoot the data.

y_zero

Logical. Force the y axis to include 0. Defaults to FALSE.

events

Optional. Dates to mark with a vertical line: either a vector of dates (names are used as labels) or a data frame whose first column holds the dates and whose second column (optional) holds labels.

bands

Optional. Periods to shade, as a data frame whose first two columns are the start and end dates. An optional third column holds the labels and an optional fourth column the fill colors.

h_lines

Optional. Numeric reference values drawn as horizontal dashed lines (names are used as labels). Only drawn when transform = "none".

legend

Logical. Show the interactive legend (click to hide or show a series, double-click to isolate it). When NULL (default), the legend is shown when there are two series or more.

end_labels

Logical. Label each line at its last visible point. When NULL (default), labels are shown when there are two series or more.

tooltip

Logical. Show the crosshair and the tooltip on hover. Defaults to TRUE.

navigator

Logical. Show the navigator (a miniature of the full series with a brush to select the visible range) under the chart. Defaults to TRUE; it is hidden automatically on very short charts.

range_buttons

Logical. Show range buttons (1M, 6M, YTD, 1Y, 5Y, All, ...), chosen from the length and frequency of the data. Only used with dates. Defaults to TRUE.

zoom

Logical. Drag horizontally on the chart to zoom into a range; double-click to reset. Defaults to TRUE.

animate

Logical. Draw the lines in with an animation on first render. Defaults to TRUE.

value_format

Optional. A d3-format string for values in the tooltip (see <https://github.com/d3/d3-format>). Defaults to ",.2~f", or "+.2~%" with transform = "percent".

value_prefix, value_suffix

Optional. Text placed before and after the values on the y axis and in the tooltip, for example "$" or " km".

date_format

Optional. A d3-time-format string for the date in the tooltip (see <https://github.com/d3/d3-time-format>). When NULL (default), it is picked from the frequency of the data (yearly, quarterly, monthly, daily or intraday).

subtitle

Optional. A subtitle shown under the title.

subtitle_font_size

The font size of the subtitle. Defaults to 13.

x_font_size, y_font_size

The font size of the axis tick labels. Defaults to 11.

grid_col

The color of the horizontal grid lines. Defaults to "#e9e9e9".

Value

An interactive SVG band chart.

Examples

airpassengers <- data.frame(
  passengers_lower = as.matrix(AirPassengers),
  passengers_upper = as.matrix(AirPassengers) + 40,
  date = zoo::as.Date(time(AirPassengers))
)

area_band(
  data = airpassengers,
  x = "date",
  y_lower = "passengers_lower",
  y_upper = "passengers_upper",
  fill = "#efb118",
  stroke = "#9c6b4e"
)



# A band around a central line, one band per group
set.seed(1)
days <- seq(as.Date("2026-01-01"), by = "day", length.out = 120)
temps <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Oslo", "Madrid"), function(city) {
  base <- if (city == "Oslo") -2 else 9
  mid <- base + 8 * sin(seq_along(days) / 38) + rnorm(120, 0, 1)
  data.frame(date = days, city = city, mean = mid,
             low = mid - runif(120, 2, 5), high = mid + runif(120, 2, 5))
}))
area_band(
  temps, x = "date", y_lower = "low", y_upper = "high", y = "mean",
  group = "city", value_format = ".1f", value_suffix = " °C",
  title = "Daily temperatures", subtitle = "Mean, with the daily minimum and maximum"
)
